typography.secondary: UNLOCKED / do not use until separately approved

rules.ai_generation_scope: Photography/scene generation only; layout identity must reuse locked assets.
rules.logo: Use official SVG only. Never regenerate, redraw, recolor or distort.
rules.waves: Use only approved AMA_WAVE and AMA_FLOW_RIBBON assets; do not redraw per piece.
rules.masks: Use only approved AMA_MASK assets or format-specific masks derived mathematically from them.
rules.icons: Minimal; only when information gain is material. No decorative icon rows.
rules.lines: Functional only. No repeated decorative separators.
rules.headline_layout: No universal left-headline/right-photo formula. Layout can vary using same locked assets.
rules.palette: No colors outside approved palette. AMA Logo Blue #03319F is logo-only.
